verdict.rationale: Mistral ships a documented, first-party public REST API with quickstart guides, official Python/TypeScript SDKs, an OpenAPI-driven endpoint reference (models list/retrieve), function calling, structured outputs, batching, and an Agents API supporting tool use, MCP, and multi-agent handoffs — clearly enabling AI-native programmatic control. missing for 10: no independent hands-on confirmation of API robustness/completeness (probe found no public openapi.json at the expected paths, and community evidence focuses on model quality/OCR rather than API usability).
